tagline: Leading North America-based steel producer with focus on value-added sheet products for the automotive industry
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue is the primary indicator of the company's overall performance. It reflects demand for its steel products and its ability to sell them in the North American market.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of goods and services by the company.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue represents the total sales generated by the company's operations.
kpis.signal: Revenue declined slightly in 2025 compared to 2024, indicating possible pressure on prices or volumes.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates the profitability of core operations before accounting for other operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Negative gross margin in 2025 suggests that production costs exceed revenues, impacting operating profitability.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, showing the profitability of operations.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Negative operating margin in 2025 highlights difficulties in covering operating costs with generated revenues.

kpis.name: Long-term Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of company debt that matures in more than one year.
kpis.description: Represents the company's financial obligations beyond one year.
kpis.signal: Long-term debt increased in 2025, which may indicate additional financing needs related to the Stelco acquisition.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (CAPEX)
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the acquisition or upgrade of physical assets such as plants and equipment.
kpis.description: CAPEX is crucial for maintaining and expanding steel production capacity.
kpis.signal: Decline in CAPEX in 2025 compared to 2024 could reflect a cautious strategy or completion of major projects.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Employee count is an indicator of operational scale and labor costs for the company.
kpis.signal: Headcount of 25,000 indicates a substantial company in the North American steel sector.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of everything the company owns.
kpis.description: Assets represent the economic resources controlled by the company.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease in total assets in 2025 could result from asset sales or depreciation.

kpis.name: Total Liabilities
kpis.explanation: Total amount of what the company owes to third parties.
kpis.description: Liabilities represent the company's financial obligations to third parties.
kpis.signal: Reduction in total liabilities in 2025 is a positive sign of debt reduction or improved obligation management.

kpis.name: Stelco Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Major acquisition of Stelco completed on November 1, 2024 to consolidate North American position.
kpis.description: The Stelco acquisition significantly altered the company's balance sheet and cash flow structure.
kpis.signal: Acquisition of Stelco for 2.5 billion dollars in 2024 represents a major consolidation and expansion milestone in the steel sector.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated or used by the company's core operating activities.
kpis.description: Negative operating cash flow may signal profitability issues or working capital management challenges.
kpis.signal: Negative operating cash flows in 2025 indicate that operations did not generate sufficient liquidity to cover expenses.

risks.title: Financial deterioration and operating losses
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at beginning of report (Item 1A), intensive language with net losses of -1,478M$ in 2025 vs -760M$ in 2024 (increased deterioration), trend UP (worsening), Capital category: high weight for viability.

risks.title: High leverage and refinancing risk
risks.score_rationale: Position mid-report (Item 8), factual language but critical figures (debt 7,253M$ vs equity 6,323M$), trend UP (debt increased 188M$ YoY), Credit category: high weight for solvency.

risks.title: Cash deterioration and insufficient liquidity
risks.score_rationale: Position mid-report (Item 8 cash flows), factual language but critical situation (cash 57M$ only), trend STABLE but structurally weak, Capital category: high weight for operations.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding ESG and GHG measurement standards
risks.score_rationale: Position beginning (Item 1A), cautious language ('may be based on standards...still developing'), trend NEW (explicitly mentioned as uncertainty), Regulation category: high weight for compliance.

risks.title: Asset impairment and goodwill
risks.score_rationale: Position mid-report (Item 8), factual language but recurring (impairment 39M$ 2025, 79M$ 2024, goodwill 125M$ 2023), trend STABLE/DOWN (less severe than before), Industrial category: medium weight.

risks.title: Environmental remediation obligations
risks.score_rationale: Position mid-report (Item 8 balance sheet), factual language but increasing amount (682M$ vs 601M$ YoY), trend UP (increase of 81M$), Environmental category: medium weight for mining operations.

risks.title: Risks related to Stelco acquisition and integration
risks.score_rationale: Position mid-report (Item 1 and Item 8), factual language (acquisition completed November 2024), trend NEW (recent acquisition), Industrial category: medium weight for integration.

risks.title: Union dependence and labor cost exposure
risks.score_rationale: Position beginning (Item 1 nature of business), factual language ('More than 90% of approximately 20,000 hourly workforce'), trend STABLE (known structure), Industrial category: medium weight.
